The main takeaway from our work is that

G protein Gβγ isoform specificity plays a role in synaptic signal processing and that the functional impact of this form of presynaptic auto inhibition on synaptic filtering properties depends on the Gβγ isoforms that are expressed in a particular neuron.
G protein βγ isoform diversity is a key feature in the design of the synaptic filter, and that this diversity is critical in the design of synapses with high temporal resolution and low latency.
